command:
set +e +o pipefail
cd core/libs/prx
echo ---- NotImplemented counts per lib
for d in */; do c=$(grep -r NotImplemented_nid_no_patch "$d" 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "$c ${d%/}"; done | sort -n | awk '$1>0' | head -80
echo ---- libSceLibcInternal unimplemented names
grep -rn -B3 NotImplemented_nid_no_patch libSceLibcInternal | grep -E 'APS5_VABI|nid|_Z' | head -80
